description:
Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

Connect your Kubera account to access your live balance sheet data, including net worth, assets, liabilities, and allocation.

The assistant uses this data to answer questions, surface patterns, and explain what’s in your portfolio.

Example questions:

- What is my current net worth?
- What stands out in my balance sheet?
- Where am I overly concentrated?
- Summarize my assets, liabilities, and entities
- What questions should I ask my advisor?
- Update my Tesla shares to 100 units

Kubera is the Balance Sheet for those who manage their own wealth. https://www.kubera.com/
